pull_request.title: Calorimeter: compare matched 10k LAr and Si-W electron responses
pull_request.head: codex/lar-10k-response-comparison
pull_request.body:
Completed the matched10,000-electron ALLEGRO-style LAr versus Si-W raw response comparison after merged#139. Task `TASK-LAR10K-RESPONSE-COMPARISON`; DES030–033 remain DRAFT / PROTOTYPE.

| Candidate | Raw SD(R)/mean(R),95% interval | Zero events | Below half own mean R |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: |
| Si-W original | 43.09% [42.22,43.95] | 42 | 1433 |
| Si-W staggered | 39.27% [38.36,40.20] | 42 | 1298 |
| LAr | 17.84% [17.31,18.40] | 0 | 183 |

All denominators are10,000; R=active deposited energy/primary total energy. Staggered Si-W minus LAr width:21.43percentage points, paired95% interval[20.42,22.48]. The LAr transition remains broad:44.18% for1.2≤|eta|<1.5, retained inclusively. Other broad LAr widths:3.52% below1.2 and7.66% above1.5. Different mean sampling fractions do not rank performance. This compares represented candidate geometry/material/envelopes; no intrinsic fixed-energy resolution, calibration, digitization or technology acceptance.

[Report and plots](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/lar-10k-response-comparison/docs/validation/lar10k/README.md) · [Protocol](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/lar-10k-response-comparison/docs/validation/lar10k/protocol.md) · [Reproduction](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/lar-10k-response-comparison/docs/validation/lar10k/reproduce.md).

Exact same original primary files: E10–80GeV,eta−3…3,full phi; ECAL-only B=0,FTFP_BERT,0.7mm cuts,5mm charged cap,twelve workers. Both retained original/staggered Si-W raw10k samples are included, distinct from PR137 calibration.

Validation:

- 10,000unique LAr primaries,all12workers,8,354,800canonical positive finite hits; complete saved readback and actual ROOT/worker/ledger/source/library hashes pass.
- Serial24/MT24:all19,027cell IDs,energies,positions bit-identical. Serial map initialization fixes the earlier first-hit race; failed legacy pilot retained separately.
- Both100event native-limit/5mm pilots pass; predeclared cap retained without tuning.
- 18focused controls pass and now run in CI; strict detector/production policies and distinct frozen Si-W geometry/material/primary contracts enforced.
- Separate PhysVal at6b745179 independently reproduces estimates,counts,quantiles,histograms,1,000shared-primary bootstrap intervals,paired contrasts and63-variable covariance. No P2+ finding.
- All8PNG figures visually inspected;24PNG/PDF/SVG exports reproduce byte-for-byte from compact summary.

Transport820.11s wall,peak3.185GiB,20.961GB ROOT,compression1/1. Timing descriptive only. Full ROOT/XML/events/logs remain local and ignored; compact binwise statistics/covariance,plots,recipes and provenance are published.


## Merge record: results, tokens and identification

Results, controls, covariance and 24 reproducible plot exports are committed. The summary/protocol/analysis/render/figure hashes have been rechecked. The scientific revision f885c9f7 passed build, unrooted validation and token-site CI. Final metadata-head CI will be checked before readiness.

All **9 closed comparison turns** are now accounted once: **85,080,526 input + 199,555 output = 85,280,081 total tokens**. Cached input (84,672,640) and reasoning output (100,103) are included subsets. The formerly active comparison parent is now closed and included in its existing canonical owner. The current merge-record turn remains active and excluded. Counters include repeated/cached context and are not a billing estimate.

| `/root/lar10k_physval` — PhysVal | Separate protocol, guard and final result assessment | `01a1d371-79d8-7f02-a1b1-083b030c657c` |
